title: 1995 AHSME Problem 5
statement: A rectangular field is \(300\) feet wide and \(400\) feet long. Random sampling indicates that there are, on the average, three ants per square inch throughout the field. [\(12\) inches = \(1\) foot.] Of the following, the number that most closely approximates the number of ants in the field is

solutions.text: The area is \(300\cdot400=120{,}000\) square feet, or \(120{,}000\cdot144=17{,}280{,}000\) square inches. The estimate is \(3(17{,}280{,}000)=51{,}840{,}000,\) closest to \(50\) million. Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: First find the field’s area in square feet
One square foot contains \(12^2\) square inches
